description: OCRScanner — SHELL / INTEGRATION component (no built-in OCR engine). Provides the upload/drag-and-drop UI for OCR workflows but does NOT extract text on its own. To obtain real results, integrate an OCR engine (e.g. Tesseract.js) or a cloud OCR API in your application and feed the recognized text back to your own state. Importantly, this shell does NOT fabricate OCR `onResult` callback is only invoked with genuine text, so it will not fire until a real OCR integration is wired up. This avoids presenting placeholder text as if it were extracted content.
title: OCRScanner
